description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying its mana cost.
When Jeweled Lotus enters, Builder's Talent's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Resolve the Builder's Talent trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
